The design-direction toolbar-contents sentence no longer lists a view toggle; a 'View-toggle ownership' subsection and the PdfToolbar component-table row state that the rail renders none; a duplicate toggle is declared a defect.

gaps_resolved.title: Ambiguous arrow-key semantics
gaps_resolved.resolution: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight page alongside PageUp/PageDown; ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End/Space are never handled and never preventDefault()ed so native scrolling survives. Recorded as the authoritative 'Keyboard arrow semantics' N4 table. Adds a JS prefers-reduced-motion guard for programmatic scroll-into-view.
